caption:
🚆 One day of trains in Germany — Thursday 15 October 2026.

43,026 trains: ICE, Intercity, regional trains and S-Bahn. Peaks: 2,741 trains on the move at 07:18 and 2,720 at 17:18 — the ripples in the curve come from the clockface timetable (Taktfahrplan).

📊 Data: DELFI e.V. via gtfs.de (CC BY 4.0). Trains follow the rail network (© OpenHistoricalMap) where it is mapped; positions interpolated between stops.
🌍 Relief: AWS Terrain Tiles · Natural Earth.
